cases.prompt: I want a 60-second animated story about moving away from home: funny opening, emotional ending, European Portuguese narration. I haven't chosen visual style. Help me start.
Write a PROPOSED 45-second visual screenplay about a lonely lighthouse keeper finding a handwritten note. Maximum 15 words of narration; include exact beat timing.
Create a 30-second bittersweet filmable story about an old musician giving away an instrument. No narration. The screenplay is not approved.
Propose a visual bible for a stylized 40-second film: a child carries a red scarf through rainy blue streets into warm sunlight. Keep character, prop and geography stable; no image assets exist.
Plan a 30-second five-shot film: a person finds a key, approaches a door, hesitates, turns the key, then reveals an empty room. Show camera motivation and exact contiguous timing.
Design an exact 30-second sound cue sheet for someone reading a letter alone: ambience, paper effects, one eight-second spoken line, music, and intentional silence. Picture locked; no audio exists.

Give a generator-neutral six-second shot packet: a character in the same coat lights a candle inside a dark library. Separate reference, video, audio and edit instructions. No provider or media is available.
A user reports repeated frames at 18–19 seconds and missing narration at 24 seconds in a locked 40-second film. No media is supplied. Propose precise scoped fixes.
